```{python}
#| label: python-data-generation
import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)
MAX_POINTS = 2000

def make_pool(group, cls):
    return [{"id": f"{group}_{cls}_{i}", "group": group, "class": cls,
             "base_x": float(np.random.normal(0, 1)),
             "base_y": float(np.random.normal(0, 1))}
            for i in range(MAX_POINTS)]

data_male_neg = make_pool("Male", "Negative")
data_male_pos = make_pool("Male", "Positive")
data_female_neg = make_pool("Female", "Negative")
data_female_pos = make_pool("Female", "Positive")

ojs_define(
    male_neg_pool=data_male_neg,
    male_pos_pool=data_male_pos,
    female_neg_pool=data_female_neg,
    female_pos_pool=data_female_pos
)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: playground-ui

d3 = require("d3@7")

// ── Layout shell ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layout = {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.id = "playground-layout";

  // ── SIDEBAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sidebar = document.createElement("div");
  sidebar.id = "sidebar";

  // Legend section
  const legendSection = document.createElement("div");
  legendSection.innerHTML = `
    <p class="sidebar-section-title">Legend</p>
    <div class="legend-card">
      <div class="legend-grid">
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="#d62728"/></svg> Male Negative
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="#1f77b4"/></svg> Male Positive
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><path d="M2,2 L10,10 M10,2 L2,10" stroke="#d62728" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg> Female Negative
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><path d="M2,2 L10,10 M10,2 L2,10" stroke="#1f77b4" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg> Female Positive
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  // Controls section
  const controlsSection = document.createElement("div");
  const controlsTitle = document.createElement("p");
  controlsTitle.className = "sidebar-section-title";
  controlsTitle.textContent = "Parameters";

  const controlsCard = document.createElement("div");
  controlsCard.className = "controls-card";
  controlsCard.append(
    viewof_total_samples,
    viewof_class_separation,
    viewof_group_disparity,
    viewof_positive_ratio,
    viewof_minority_ratio,
    viewof_noise_male_pos,
    viewof_noise_male_neg,
    viewof_noise_female_pos,
    viewof_noise_female_neg
  );

  controlsSection.append(controlsTitle, controlsCard);
  sidebar.append(legendSection, controlsSection);

  // ── CHART AREA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const chartArea = document.createElement("div");
  chartArea.id = "chart-area";

  const chartHeader = document.createElement("div");
  chartHeader.className = "chart-header";
  chartHeader.innerHTML = `
    <p class="chart-title">Scatter Distribution</p>
    <p class="chart-subtitle">Adjust parameters on the left to explore group dynamics</p>
  `;

  const statsBar = document.createElement("div");
  statsBar.className = "stats-bar";
  statsBar.id = "stats-bar";

  const chartContainer = document.createElement("div");
  chartContainer.className = "chart-container";
  chartContainer.id = "chart-container";

  chartArea.append(chartHeader, statsBar, chartContainer);

  root.append(sidebar, chartArea);
  return root;
}

// ── Inputs (hidden – we mount them manually above) ───────────────────────────
viewof_total_samples  = Inputs.range([100, 2000], {value: 500,  step: 50,   label: "Total Samples"})
viewof_class_separation = Inputs.range([0, 6],    {value: 3,    step: 0.1,  label: "Class Separation (Y)"})
viewof_group_disparity  = Inputs.range([0, 6],    {value: 3,    step: 0.1,  label: "Group Separation (X)"})
viewof_positive_ratio = Inputs.range([0.05, 0.95],{value: 0.5,  step: 0.05, label: "Positive Ratio"})
viewof_minority_ratio = Inputs.range([0.05, 0.95],{value: 0.5,  step: 0.05, label: "Female Ratio"})

viewof_noise_male_pos = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Noise (Male Positive)"})
viewof_noise_male_neg = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Noise (Male Negative)"})
viewof_noise_female_pos = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Noise (Female Positive)"})
viewof_noise_female_neg = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Noise (Female Negative)"})

total_samples     = Generators.input(viewof_total_samples)
class_separation  = Generators.input(viewof_class_separation)
group_disparity   = Generators.input(viewof_group_disparity)
positive_ratio    = Generators.input(viewof_positive_ratio)
minority_ratio    = Generators.input(viewof_minority_ratio)
noise_male_pos    = Generators.input(viewof_noise_male_pos)
noise_male_neg    = Generators.input(viewof_noise_male_neg)
noise_female_pos  = Generators.input(viewof_noise_female_pos)
noise_female_neg  = Generators.input(viewof_noise_female_neg)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: reactive-data
active_data = {
  const n_female = Math.floor(total_samples * minority_ratio);
  const n_male = total_samples - n_female;
  const n_female_pos = Math.floor(n_female * positive_ratio);
  const n_female_neg = n_female - n_female_pos;
  const n_male_pos = Math.floor(n_male * positive_ratio);
  const n_male_neg = n_male - n_male_pos;

  const applyNoise = (data, count, originalClass, flippedClass, noiseRatio) => {
    const nFlipped = Math.floor(count * noiseRatio);
    return data.slice(0, count).map((d, i) => ({
      ...d,
      original_class: originalClass,
      class: i < nFlipped ? flippedClass : originalClass,
      is_noise: i < nFlipped // Let's also track if a point was flipped just in case you need it later
    }));
  };

  return [
    ...applyNoise(male_neg_pool, n_male_neg, "Negative", "Positive", noise_male_neg),
    ...applyNoise(male_pos_pool, n_male_pos, "Positive", "Negative", noise_male_pos),
    ...applyNoise(female_neg_pool, n_female_neg, "Negative", "Positive", noise_female_neg),
    ...applyNoise(female_pos_pool, n_female_pos, "Positive", "Negative", noise_female_pos)
  ];
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: chart-render
chart = {
  // Dimensions
  const container = document.getElementById("chart-container");
  const W = Math.max((container?.clientWidth || 700) - 40, 400);
  const H = Math.max((container?.clientHeight || 480) - 40, 380);
  const margin = {top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 48, left: 52};
  const innerW = W - margin.left - margin.right;
  const innerH = H - margin.top - margin.bottom;

  // Color map
  const getColor = d => d.class === "Positive" ? "#1f77b4" : "#d62728";

  const symbolGenerator = d3.symbol();

  const getPath = (d, size) => {
    symbolGenerator.type(d.group === "Male" ? d3.symbolCircle : d3.symbolCross).size(size);
    return symbolGenerator();
  };

  // Scales
  const xScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([0, innerW]);
  const yScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([innerH, 0]);

  // Build/reuse SVG
  let svg = d3.select("#chart-container svg");
  if (svg.empty()) {
    svg = d3.select("#chart-container")
      .append("svg")
      .attr("width", W)
      .attr("height", H)
      .style("display", "block");
  } else {
    svg.attr("width", W).attr("height", H);
  }

  let g = svg.select("g.inner");
  if (g.empty()) {
    g = svg.append("g").attr("class", "inner")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);
  }

  // Grid lines
  let gridGroup = g.select(".grid");
  if (gridGroup.empty()) gridGroup = g.append("g").attr("class", "grid");
  gridGroup.selectAll(".grid-h")
    .data(yScale.ticks(6))
    .join("line").attr("class","grid-h")
    .attr("x1", 0).attr("x2", innerW)
    .attr("y1", d => yScale(d)).attr("y2", d => yScale(d))
    .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width", 1);
  gridGroup.selectAll(".grid-v")
    .data(xScale.ticks(6))
    .join("line").attr("class","grid-v")
    .attr("x1", d => xScale(d)).attr("x2", d => xScale(d))
    .attr("y1", 0).attr("y2", innerH)
    .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width", 1);

  // Axes
  let xAxisG = g.select(".x-axis");
  if (xAxisG.empty()) xAxisG = g.append("g").attr("class","x-axis");
  xAxisG.attr("transform", `translate(0,${innerH})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(xScale).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
    .call(ax => {
      ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
      ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
      ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)");
    });

  let yAxisG = g.select(".y-axis");
  if (yAxisG.empty()) yAxisG = g.append("g").attr("class","y-axis");
  yAxisG.call(d3.axisLeft(yScale).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
    .call(ax => {
      ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
      ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
      ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)");
    });

  // Axis labels
  let xLabel = g.select(".x-label");
  if (xLabel.empty()) {
    g.append("text").attr("class","x-label")
      .attr("x", innerW / 2).attr("y", innerH + 40)
      .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("fill","#475569")
      .attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif")
      .text("Feature X  (Group Disparity axis)");
  }
  let yLabel = g.select(".y-label");
  if (yLabel.empty()) {
    g.append("text").attr("class","y-label")
      .attr("transform","rotate(-90)")
      .attr("x", -innerH / 2).attr("y", -40)
      .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("fill","#475569")
      .attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif")
      .text("Feature Y  (Class Separation axis)");
  }

  // Points
  const getX = d => xScale(d.base_x + (d.group === "Female" ? group_disparity : 0));
  const getY = d => yScale(d.base_y + (d.original_class === "Positive" ? class_separation : 0));

  g.selectAll("path.point")
    .data(active_data, d => d.id)
    .join(
      enter => enter.append("path")
        .attr("class", "point")
        .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getX(d)},${getY(d)})`)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 0))
        .attr("fill", getColor).attr("opacity", 0)
        .call(e => e.transition().duration(450)
          .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 60)).attr("opacity", 0.72)),
      update => update.call(u => u.transition().duration(450)
        .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getX(d)},${getY(d)})`)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 60))
        .attr("fill", getColor).attr("opacity", 0.72)),
      exit => exit.call(x => x.transition().duration(280)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 0)).attr("opacity", 0).remove())
    );

  // Update stats bar
  const statsBar = document.getElementById("stats-bar");
  if (statsBar) {
    const nMin = active_data.filter(d => d.group === "Female").length;
    const nMaj = active_data.filter(d => d.group === "Male").length;
    const nPos = active_data.filter(d => d.class === "Positive").length;
    statsBar.innerHTML = `
      <div class="stat-pill">Total <strong>${active_data.length}</strong></div>
      <div class="stat-pill">Male <strong>${nMaj}</strong></div>
      <div class="stat-pill">Female <strong>${nMin}</strong></div>
      <div class="stat-pill">Positive <strong>${nPos}</strong></div>
    `;
  }

  return null;
}
```
